Atif Aslam Reflects on Decade-Long India Ban

Pakistani singer Atif Aslam has spoken about the decade-long ban preventing him from performing in India. In recent statements, Aslam expressed that he misses his Indian fans. However, some reports also state that Aslam thanked those who banned him and indicated he does not miss working in India, with fans reportedly listening to his music via VPN.
